world.title: Uefa to boycott World Cups if Fifa plans approved

world.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
world.description: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

world.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
world.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

world.title: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
world.description: The territory's leader said the influx is overwhelming resources and urged the Spanish government to intervene.

world.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
world.description: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

world.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
world.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

world.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
world.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

world.title: Father of teen school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
world.description: "It is clear you failed as a parent," the judge told Colin Gray, who was found guilty earlier this year on charges stemming from the deadly 2024 school attack.

world.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
world.description: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

world.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
world.description: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.

world.title: Thousands evacuated in Crete as wildfires threaten tourist resorts
world.description: Strong winds have fanned the flames in the Rethymno region as wildfires continue to ravage the Greek island.

world.title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents
world.description: It marks a change of tone for his administration, which has taken a more hands-off approach to the technology.

world.description: The 70 year old has been in detention since November 2024 and faces treason charges, which he denies.

world.title: Australia takes Telegram to court over alleged failure to remove 'pro-terror' material
world.description: Telegram told the BBC it rejects the allegations and will contest them in court.

world.title: Singapore fines French teen $465 for viral straw-licking stunt

US.title: Mortgage rates hit their highest level in a year, driven by war and inflation concerns

US.title: After Fauci Senate hearing, experts worry about 'chilling effect' on public health
US.description: The accusations against Dr. Anthony Fauci, once the nation's leading infectious disease expert, have some experts worrying that these events may further erode public health staffing in the U.S.

US.title: The Trump administration wants $10 million more to cover its July Fourth celebrations
US.description: Congress allocated $150 million for 250th birthday events. The Trump-backed group that planned the state fair and July 4th fireworks is asking for an additional $10 million in reimbursements.

US.title: Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you
US.description: Solo living, solo travel, and solo dining are all being embraced as more adults are choosing to remain single. Many Americans aren't interested in dating, and being single is a symbol of autonomy

US.title: European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step
US.description: In an unprecedented step, European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

US.title: Trump says he 'may' pull Blanche AG nomination temporarily
US.description: The news comes as two key Republicans are withholding their support over concerns about the Justice Department's deal with President Trump.

US.title: The economy slowed a bit -- but Americans continued to spend
US.description: The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, according to the Commerce Department. That's a modest slowdown from the previous quarter — but consumer spending picked up steam.

US.title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court holds its first-ever hearing after 30 years
US.description: Congress created the Alien Terrorist Removal Court in 1996 to make it easier for the Justice Department to use classified evidence to deport people from U.S. soil.

US.title: Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum
US.description: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.

US.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill 10 and a missile falls in Poland
US.description: A Russian missile and drone barrage across Ukraine killed at least 10 civilians, including children, and NATO scrambled jets after one of the missiles crossed the border into Poland.
